## Battery recycling

Battery recycling recovers metals such as lithium, cobalt and nickel from spent cells [1]. The main industrial routes are pyrometallurgy and hydrometallurgy, and their economics depend on the cell chemistry and on the cost of collection [2].

Collection and safe transport remain the largest practical obstacles [1][2].
